subject: Request: one-time premium and equity refresh for critical ModelOps hire (Nora Patel)
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@greenfield-talent.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate counter + timeline — Nora Patel

Hi Alex,

Nora (ex-ModelCore) called this morning. She really liked the team and the role but received a competing in-house offer from CloudScale that is materially higher on base and includes a $25k sign-on. Nora asked if Redwood can come closer to the market to avoid losing her.

She sent a short counter-proposal (attached) with the following asks:
- Base: $225,000 (current band midpoint for this req is $185k–$205k)
- One-time sign-on: $30,000
- Equity: 0.30% RSU refresh at first performance milestone (adds ~0.05% on top of the package we already extended)

Candidate is asking for a decision by end of day Wednesday (6/16). Shes motivated to join Redwood but has a tight window.

Attachments: Nora_Patel_Counter-Proposal.pdf

Elaine Park
Senior Recruiter | Greenfield Talent
elaine@greenfield-talent.com
+1 (415) 555-0187
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate counter + timeline — Nora Patel (approval request)

Team,

Forwarding Elaines note — Nora is a high-priority ModelOps hire (REQ-4821). Brief context and ask:

Why this matters
- Deep experience shipping KV-cache and quantization pipelines at scale (worked on the ModelCore LLM infra team that shipped their 512k context rollout).
- Strong ref from Maya at ScaleBridge; likely to materially shorten ramp on our inference compilation work.

Comp proposal I'm asking us to approve today if possible:
- Base: $220,000 (~7% above top of band)
- Sign-on: $25,000 one-time
- Equity: 0.25% one-time refresh vesting over 24 months (accelerated cliff at 6 months)

Rationale: competitive counteroffer from CloudScale at $230k + $25k sign-on. If we want to close quickly, this package is a pragmatic middle ground that keeps the total comp anchored to our bands while offering a one-time, non-recurring premium + equity refresh tied to milestone outcomes.

Budget impact: this would come from FY27 hiring premium pool for Model Infra (headcount already approved for REQ-4821). Finance will need sign-off for the sign-on.

Request: Approval for the one-time premium and equity refresh, and permission to finalize offer verbally with candidate before Thursday EOD.

Attachments: Market_Comp_Band_Snapshot.xlsx (I pulled the current band data and recent comps)

Alex Martinez
VP, Model Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T13:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate counter + timeline — Nora Patel (approval request)

Alex — thanks for the context. A couple quick questions before I can sign off:
1) Can you confirm the budget line and remaining pool for FY27 hiring premium? I need a dollar figure to route to Finance.
2) For the equity refresh, please confirm whether this will be an additional grant or reallocation from unvested equity in the req. We prefer a one-time grant but need the exact grant ID for equity ops.
3) Do we have a final expected start date? That affects when the sign-on is paid (pre- or post-start).

Ill pull the comp snapshot and run it by Finance after you reply. If you can get a quick note from Hiring Manager (you) on the business impact and 2-sentence justification, Ill route for expedited approval.

-Marissa
Director, Talent & Total Rewards
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HR Operations <hr@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-14T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate counter + timeline — Nora Patel (approval request)

Thanks Alex — Im supportive of a targeted premium for this hire given the strategic impact and the competitive counter. Conditions for my approval:
- Sign-on capped at $25k payable 30 days after start (unless candidate requests otherwise and Hiring Manager confirms business need).
- Equity refresh to be a one-time grant of 0.20% (rounded) administered by Equity Ops; include a milestone-based acceleration schedule as you proposed.
- Hiring Manager must commit to start date within 45 days of acceptance.

If Marissa and Finance are OK with the numbers and the funding source, I approve moving forward to finalize.

-Tessa
VP, Talent & People Operations
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, HR Operations <hr@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate counter + timeline — Nora Patel (approval request)

Thanks all — quick updates:
- Budget: we have $60,000 remaining in the FY27 hiring premium pool for Model Infra. The proposed package uses $25k of that pool for the sign-on; remainder preserves runway for one additional premium if needed.
- Equity: Equity Ops confirmed they can issue a one-time 0.25% refresh (grant ref: GR-REQ4821-REF25) with a 6-month accelerated cliff.
- Start date: target start 8/2/2027 (within 45-day window).

Marissa — can you route to Finance for the $25k sign-on payment approval? If Finance confirms, Tessas conditional approval stands and Recruiting should finalize the verbal.

Ill ask Elaine to present the updated package to Nora this morning and push for verbal acceptance by EOD today.

Alex
VP, Model Infrastructure
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@gmail.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@greenfield-talent.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer update — thank you

Hi Alex / Elaine,

Thank you — I appreciate the team moving quickly. I spoke with Elaine and the verbal offer you shared is acceptable. Id like to receive the updated written offer and plan to sign once I review the legal language. Target start date 8/2/2027 works for me.

Looking forward to joining Redwood.

Best,
Nora Patel
Senior ModelOps Engineer
